cues: Carbon leaves as carbon monoxide, flaring at the mouth.
Silicon, manganese and phosphorus form acidic oxides that the lime turns into slag, and that is why the lining must be basic.
The phosphate slag is sold as fertiliser.
No fuel is needed: the burning impurities supply all the heat.
A charge takes about forty minutes.
